away.name: Jonas Johansson
away.news: With Linus Ullmark (lower body) expected to miss another week, the Senators will continue to roll with Samuel Ersson and Jonas Johansson, turning to Johansson on Tuesday against the Vegas Golden Knights. The 31-year-old was far from stellar in his only outing this season, allowing four goals on 28 shots (.857 SV%) in a 7-4 loss to the New York Rangers. The Senators enter Tuesday's game as +139 road underdogs against a Vegas Golden Knights team that has scored only three goals in its past two games (0-1-1).

home.name: Adin Hill
home.news: Hill won his first four games of the season but is coming off a forgettable fifth, allowing six goals on 31 shots (.806 SV%) in a 6-2 loss to the St. Louis Blues. The 30-year-old Hill has a 2.95 GAA and .882 SV% in five games (4-1-0). The Golden Knights enter Tuesday's outing as -155 home favourites against an Ottawa Senators team coming off a 7-4 win over the New York Rangers.

away.name: Leevi Merilainen
away.news: Meriläinen led the Canucks onto the ice for warmups.

home.name: Lukas Dostal
home.news: Dostal has played eight of 11 games for the Ducks this season and will return to the crease on Tuesday. The 26-year-old Czech goalie was serviceable in his most recent outing, saving 28 of 32 shots (.875 SV%) in a 5-4 win over the Philadelphia Flyers. He has a 3.27 GAA and .880 SV% in eight games (4-4-0). The Ducks enter Tuesday's contest as sizeable -208 home favourites against a league-worst 2-10-1 Vancouver Canucks team that has scored two or fewer goals in nine of its last 10 games (0-9-1).

away.name: Colten Ellis
away.news: Still without Alex Lyon (upper body), the Sabres have mostly relied on Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen, but they will turn to Ellis on Tuesday. The 26-year-old Ellis has not played since October 12th, when he allowed two goals on nine shots (.778 SV%) in a relief performance in a 5-3 win over the Florida Panthers. Ellis has a 3.19 GAA and .864 SV% in three appearances (1-1-0). The Sabres enter Tuesday's contest as -143 road favourites against a San Jose Sharks team that has scored 16 goals in their past three games (2-1-0).

home.name: Yaroslav Askarov
home.news: Askarov started the season with a dreadful 4.00 GAA and .848 SV% in his first five games (2-3-0), but has turned things around in recent outings. In his past two games (1-1-0), the the 24-year-old Russian goalie has stopped 70 of 74 shots (.946 SV%) and hopes to carry that momentum into Tuesday's game against the Buffalo Sabres. The Sharks enter Tuesday's game as +129 road underdogs against a Sabres team on a three-game losing skid (0-1-2).
